en-US.name: Sentinel+
en-US.summary: Autonomous Infrastructure & Code Sentry for Alexa+ using Bedrock and MCP
en-US.description: Sentinel+ provides real-time infrastructure sentry capabilities for developers. Inspect Linux kernel sockets, predict memory leaks using statistical Z-scores, and stage automated GitHub Pull Requests with Two-Phase Commit safety gates.

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Open Sentinel+ web simulator or connect via Streamable HTTP MCP at /sse and /mcp/call.
